text: No, we need all the core work to be done first. Ideally, start with the core work that'll give you a good warm-up, and then you go to the rest of the stuff. That's how I like my model to be put together, but if they want to be able to move the core work to after the plyos or after the strength, that's fine too. They can have the option of moving it around that core block. Ideally, for me, I want everybody to start with core work so they can get it out of the way. Some athletes like to do it at the end, so that's why I want them to be able to move it around if they need to.
